title: No Tarium enrollment without project-specific owner authorization
abstract: Do not enroll, remove or present a repository as an official Tarium member unless the owner explicitly authorized that specific membership operation on the named public repository. Project creation, naming, or public visibility does not grant enrollment.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only explicitly authorized work on independent public Tarium projects

remarks: Public-source rule normalization reviewed as a distinct project-specific atom; overlapping general rules retained.
